title: Kehti thi  baane muztar alvida
body:
Kehti thi baanoe muztar alvida
chaar saala meri dukhtar alvida
Ae meri tutlaane waali laadli
meri beti maahe paikar alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
sone waali seenae shabbir ki
zeenate aaghoshe maadar alvida
durre khaanne waali meri naaznee'n
marne waali zulm uthaakar alvida
